news.title: Karabakh Company October Convoy
news.summary:
Karabakh Company successfully hosted its October Convoy, bringing together drivers for an enjoyable journey filled with teamwork, discipline, and safe driving. Special thanks to all participating VTCs, drivers, and the UCL Media Team for their support and contribution to making this event memorable.

Golden Wheels, Endless Miles.
